title: Check: Surface Area of Cones and Spheres (C)

questions.stem: A cone has a base radius of $3\text{ cm}$ and a slant height of $5\text{ cm}$. What is its total surface area in terms of $\pi$?
questions.explanation: Total surface area $= \pi rl + \pi r^2 = \pi(3)(5) + \pi(9) = 15\pi + 9\pi = 24\pi\text{ cm}^2$.
